grwl.interpretation: Dataset-informed global width abstraction; terrain classes and multipliers are modelling assumptions, not observed terrain classifications or a geolocated reach.

era5.search_scope: project data, data_validation, outputs and active source references

conclusions: GRWL global summary medians reproduce the configured width midpoints.
CHIRPS precipitation factors are not the active discharge multipliers; no rainfall-runoff calibration is implemented.
HydroSHEDS direction and accumulation rasters are present but no extraction feeds the reported slope or discharge. Those values are prescribed assumptions.
No ERA5 input or implemented ingestion is evidenced.
None of these resources supplies observed tracer-density labels or field validation.
